column1: # GAMS source lint rules. APPEND-ONLY, one rule per line (M7).
# kind=forbid: any line matching `pattern` is a violation (partner/window empty).
# kind=require_within: a line matching `pattern` must be followed within `window`

column7: abort.noError halts execution silently at rc=0 with no status line (GATE-02)

column1: # ── GATE-04 — execute and $call need SEPARATE rules: $onCheckErrorLevel
#    governs $call ONLY, measured (it does not make `execute 'false'` fail).

column7: a failing `execute` returns rc=0; set execute.checkErrorLevel before it (GATE-04)
a failing $call returns rc=0; use $call.checkErrorLevel or $onCheckErrorLevel (GATE-04)
$onMulti* silently REPLACES a symbol at rc=0 (GATE-04, REPR-04)
assigning execError forges the error state (GATE-04)
